notes.title: Update Note v1.4.4.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing. We have some updates for you.


 The car's default speed has slightly increased.
 If you pick up fuel and don't get in the car, the speed will decrease after a while no matter where you go.
 If you don't clear the stones and get in the car, your speed will slow down wherever you go shortly after.

We will always strive to provide a better gaming experience. Please continue to give us your feedback! Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note v1.4.4
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing. We have some updates for you.


After acquiring oil, if the player continues to run past the car, they will get tired and slow down.
If you clear all the games, you can select the play section.

We will always strive to provide a better gaming experience. Please continue to give us your feedback! Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note v1.4.3.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing. We have some updates for you.

The ghost will appear later when you leave the road.
Slowed down the ghost during the reverse event.Slowed down the ghost during the reverse event.

We will always strive to provide a better gaming experience. Please continue to give us your feedback! Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note v1.4.3
notes.content:
Hello, this is Callmerat Games.

We would like to inform you that the tunnel event and reverse event have been running smoothly since version v1.4.2.

If you encounter the same issue, please let us know. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

We would like to express our gratitude to all those who have patiently waited by adding 
three horror events starting from the gas station chase.

Other Updates

 Fixed an issue where the game would not proceed to the next event after a game over following the reverse event.
 Added ghost footsteps sound when pressing the bridge switch.

We will always strive to provide a better gaming experience. Please continue to give us your feedback! Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note v1.4.2
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing. Here are the update details:

Tunnel Event

 Reduced the speed of the ghost during the tunnel chase.
 Enabled access to the main menu during the tunnel event.
 Changed the ghost spawn location after clearing the rocks and getting into the car.
 If the player exits the tunnel without a car, they will get tired and their speed will slow down.

Reversing Event

 Death occurs if you avoid the ghost and move forward during the reversing event.
 Reduced the speed of the ghost during the reversing event.

Miscellaneous

 Replaced player movement code.
 Reduced player running speed.
 Leaving the road is prohibited.
 Death occurs if the car flips over.
 Fixed viewpoint within the car.
 Adjusted for closer ghost pursuit.
 Made the screen shake upon death in the car.

We sincerely thank those who provided feedback.
We always strive to create a better gaming experience. Please continue to provide feedback!

notes.title: Update Note v1.4.1
notes.content:
Thank you very much for playing. Here are the update details:

Gas Station Event

 Modified to result in immediate game over if you don't go to the gas station.
 Adjusted ghost spawn locations upon acquiring fuel.

Tunnel Event

 Modified to allow clearing the rocks immediately after getting out of the car in the tunnel.
 Adjusted so you cannot pass before clearing the rocks.

Reversing Event

 Made the navigation more visible at the start of the reversing event.

Miscellaneous

 Accelerated the ending credits speed.

We always strive to create a better gaming experience. Please continue to provide feedback!

notes.title: Update Note v1.2
notes.content:
Hello, This is Callmerat Games.

Here are the update details:


 Double the number of events and changes, shorten the interval
 Screen brightness adjustment feature
 Playtime: 15 minutes
 Being chased event

 Ending messages

You can enjoy the demo game through the link provided above. Thank you.
